doc.brief: Specifies which features the print dialog should offer.
doc.md:
Specifies which features the print dialog should offer.

If neither %GTK_PRINT_CAPABILITY_GENERATE_PDF nor
%GTK_PRINT_CAPABILITY_GENERATE_PS is specified, GTK assumes that all
formats are supported.

collate.brief: Print dialog will allow to collate multiple copies.
collate.md: Print dialog will allow to collate multiple copies.

copies.brief: Print dialog will allow to print multiple copies.
copies.md: Print dialog will allow to print multiple copies.

generate_pdf.brief: The program will send the document to the printer in PDF format
generate_pdf.md:
The program will send the document to
  the printer in PDF format

generate_ps.brief: The program will send the document to the printer in Postscript format
generate_ps.md:
The program will send the document to
  the printer in Postscript format

number_up.brief: Print dialog will offer printing multiple pages per sheet
number_up.md:
Print dialog will offer printing multiple
  pages per sheet

number_up_layout.brief: Print dialog will allow to rearrange pages when printing multiple pages per sheet
number_up_layout.md:
Print dialog will allow to rearrange
  pages when printing multiple pages per sheet

page_set.brief: Print dialog will offer printing even/odd pages.
page_set.md: Print dialog will offer printing even/odd pages.

preview.brief: Print dialog will offer a preview
preview.md: Print dialog will offer a preview

reverse.brief: Print dialog will allow to print pages in reverse order.
reverse.md: Print dialog will allow to print pages in reverse order.

scale.brief: Print dialog will allow to scale the output.
scale.md: Print dialog will allow to scale the output.
